title.value: MII VS Microbiology LOINC Ontology NAA Detection Any Technique

description.value: Proposal: LOINC codes of the microbiology request 'Specific determination: Nucleic-acid detection — any or no technique', computed by ECL over the LOINC Ontology 2026-10-21. Threshold presence / presence / identity of a microbial nucleic acid, regardless of technique. The reference set for the specific-determination request; includes 35492-8 (MRSA DNA by probe with target amplification). Parts: LOINC enumeration (2500, LOINC 2.83), LOINC Ontology observables without LOINC code (7), and the ECL as an intensional include. ECL: `<< 363787002 |Observable entity (observable entity)| : 370130000 |Property (attribute)| = (118589004 |Threshold (property) (qualifier value)| OR 705057003 |Presence (property) (qualifier value)| OR 118584009 |Presence or identity (property) (qualifier value)|), 246093002 |Component (attribute)| = << 117174000 |Nucleic acid sequence with relative specificity for microorganism (substance)|`
